title: How to Send Money Safely to bKash in Bangladesh in 5 Easy Steps
summary: Are you sending money to your loved ones in Bangladesh? Learn how you can send money to bKash with Remitly in a few steps.

## Send Money to bKash in 5 Easy Steps


Supporting a friend or family member with a payment to their bKash account? No problem, just follow the steps below.


1. For first-time users,[download the Remitly app](https://remitly.onelink.me/94Wt/p44y7u04) and create an account. Then select Bangladesh as your destination country.
2. Enter the amount you wish to send.
3. Choose Mobile Money as your delivery method and bKash as your location.
4. Enter your recipient’s full name and phone number, having made sure they have a bKash account already.
5. Enter your payment details.


It’s as simple as that. You can now check all the details are correct before making your[BDT transfer](https://www.remitly.com/blog/finance/bangladeshi-taka-guide-how-to-convert-exchange-and-transfer-taka/) happen. ## What We Love about bKash


Launched in 2011, bKash lets people manage their money using only their mobile phones, and is a fantastic example of how technology can make a real difference to people’s lives. Fortune magazine agrees – it listed bKash as one of the top 50 companies to Change the World in 2017.


One of the reasons bKash was developed to give millions of ordinary Bangladeshis – many of whom live in rural regions and haven’t traditionally been able to access banking services – an easy way to pay bills, manage their finances and receive takas from family members working in cities. With this in mind, it’s rather fitting that bKash can now be used by Bangladeshis to receive money from loved ones all over the world.
